## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A short one-fascicle ritual *niànsòng fǎ* 念誦法 — a recitation manual — for the *Cintāmaṇi-cakra-dhāraṇī*, translated by **Bǎosīwéi** ([寶思惟](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AF%B6%E6%80%9D%E6%83%9F)). The text is the practical companion to Bǎosīwéi's parent dhāraṇī-sūtra ([KR6j0290](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0290) = T20n1083), giving the *mūla-mantra* and the recitation procedure stripped of the narrative frame.

**Abstract**

The work opens with the *gēnběn zhòu* 根本呪 — the *mūla-dhāraṇī* — given in transliteration. The body of the text then walks through the practitioner's procedure: visualisation of the deity holding the *cintāmaṇi* and the *cakra*, recitation count, the supplementary mudrā-spells, and the dedication. As an extract-companion to [KR6j0290](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0290), the manual is an example of the *mìyán niànsòng* (祕密言念誦) ritual genre that proliferated in the late-7th and 8th centuries: the parent dhāraṇī-sūtra carried the mythic and doctrinal frame; the recitation manual carried the practical apparatus. The two texts probably circulated together as a paired set in the late-7th-century translation milieu of [寶思惟](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AF%B6%E6%80%9D%E6%83%9F) Bǎosīwéi and [菩提流志](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%8F%A9%E6%8F%90%E6%B5%81%E5%BF%97) Bodhiruci.
